skill.name: canvas-design
skill.description: Create polished visual art as PNG or PDF files using a written design philosophy and curated typography.
skill.summary: Create art-forward static canvas designs with a design philosophy, local font assets, and refined visual composition.
skill.author: anthropics

security_audit.summary: Most static findings are false positives from OFL license text and Markdown formatting in SKILL.md. The confirmed low findings are bundled binary font files, and semantic review found a medium-risk instruction that permits downloading unreviewed fonts.

remediation.suggestion: Prefer bundled fonts by default. Require user confirmation before downloading external font files or other third-party assets.

remediation.issue: Bundled binary font assets are not inspectable as text
remediation.suggestion: Document font provenance and licenses, and keep hashes for each bundled font file in the release process.

content.value_statement: Static art requests often need stronger visual direction than a simple layout prompt. This skill builds a design philosophy and turns it into refined PNG or PDF artwork.
actual_capabilities: Creates a written design philosophy before producing the final visual artifact.
Generates single-page PNG or PDF artwork for posters, art pieces, and static designs.
Uses bundled font files from the canvas-fonts directory for varied typography.
Guides composition, color, spacing, hierarchy, and visual refinement decisions.
Supports multi-page art sets when the user asks for additional pages.
limitations: It focuses on static visual output, not interactive websites or animated media.
It may need separate rendering tools to create the final PNG or PDF file.
It does not verify external font licenses if new fonts are downloaded.
It should not copy living artists or protected works without transformation.

use_cases.title: Poster Concept Art
use_cases.description: Create a visually rich poster from a short theme, event idea, or abstract prompt.

use_cases.title: Editorial Art Direction
use_cases.description: Turn a story, essay, or campaign concept into a refined visual direction and canvas output.

use_cases.title: Presentation Cover Artwork
use_cases.description: Produce a polished cover image that communicates tone through composition, color, and typography.

prompt_templates.title: Beginner Poster
prompt_templates.scenario: Use when you need one polished static design from a simple idea.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a single-page PNG poster about [topic]. Build a design philosophy first, then create the final canvas with minimal text.

prompt_templates.title: Brand Mood Artwork
prompt_templates.scenario: Use when a team needs a visual tone without a full brand system.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a PDF artwork that expresses the mood of [brand or project]. Use restrained typography, strong composition, and a clear design philosophy.

prompt_templates.title: Conceptual Editorial Piece
prompt_templates.scenario: Use when the design should carry subtle meaning for a specific audience.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create an editorial-style canvas for [audience] about [concept]. Include a subtle reference to [reference] without explaining it directly.

prompt_templates.title: Advanced Multi-Page Series
prompt_templates.scenario: Use when you need a cohesive set of related static artworks.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a three-page PDF art series for [theme]. Keep one design philosophy, vary each page, and make the series feel cohesive.

output_examples.input: Create a poster for a quiet launch event about sustainable materials.
output_examples.output: A design philosophy named Material Silence, plus a PNG poster using muted color fields, sparse labels, and careful negative space.

output_examples.input: Make a cover image for a strategy deck about resilient systems.
output_examples.output: A refined PDF cover with modular patterns, restrained typography, and a visual language based on structure, rhythm, and recovery.

output_examples.input: Create a small art series for a music festival with a subtle ocean theme.
output_examples.output: A multi-page PDF series with related compositions, varied typography, and abstract forms that suggest tides without literal illustration.

best_practices: Provide the theme, audience, format, and any required text before generation starts.
Ask for PNG when you need image sharing, and PDF when you need print or presentation use.
Review the design philosophy before requesting major visual changes.
anti_patterns: Do not ask it to imitate a specific living artist or protected brand style.
Do not use it for dense reports that need many paragraphs of readable text.
Do not allow external font downloads unless licensing and source trust are clear.

faq.question: What does this skill create?
faq.answer: It creates static visual artwork as PNG or PDF files, usually with a written design philosophy.

faq.question: Can it create posters?
faq.answer: Yes. Posters are a primary use case, especially when the design should feel polished and art-forward.

faq.question: Does it support multiple pages?
faq.answer: Yes. It can create additional related pages when the prompt asks for a series or booklet style output.

faq.question: Does it include fonts?
faq.answer: Yes. The skill includes a canvas-fonts directory with bundled font files for design variation.

faq.question: Can it make interactive designs?
faq.answer: No. It is intended for static PNG, PDF, and design philosophy outputs.

faq.question: Is it safe to use external fonts?
faq.answer: Use bundled fonts first. Confirm source trust and licensing before downloading any external font.
